reuse.reason: The pinned official account packages expose the signed-in DeepSeek Platform identity, not product user administration; no corresponding local-user admin plugin or UI implementation exists to mount or fork. This independently authored Worker adapter composes the pinned Better Auth admin plugin's exported API, schema and ban/session hooks, restricting exposed actions to listing, role assignment, ban/unban and session revocation. No purchased template or official DSH source is copied.
gaps: User deletion, impersonation, administrator-set passwords and admin-created accounts are unavailable; their upstream Better Auth endpoints are not mounted. Schema migration and an explicit administrator allowlist are required. Stored role labels do not grant deployment-administrator authority.
